problem: Reversing weights before delegating to reference_impl and un-reversing the result flips remainder tie-breaking from lowest index to highest index, so allocate('1', [1,1,1]) returns [0.33, 0.33, 0.34] instead of [0.34, 0.33, 0.33].
Production allocate now depends on reference_impl, a test-oracle copy of the old implementation, so oracle comparisons become circular and the bare module name can be shadowed via sys.path.
Materializing and reversing weights before any validation changes which error surfaces first, e.g. allocate(1, [0, 'a']) raises InvalidOperation instead of ValueError.
_to_decimal and the Fraction import are now dead code and duplicate the copy in reference_impl.
